title: Validate CCP2 workload and true-delivery reporting
description:
Scope: focused workload/result checks under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/python/tests/sim/scenarios/ and the existing simulator reporting/validation path used by /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Compare single versus multiple receivers at identical offered workloads and declared radio resources. Independently enumerate application deliveries and complete emissions, then verify offered/admitted/delivered/expired counts, latency population, loss and airtime limits. No speculative capacity multiplier, CPU percentage or RF-measurement claim is in scope.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse the existing simulator/report format and add small contract checks, not a new benchmark framework. Capacity conclusions remain conditional software observations with failures visible.
acceptance_criteria: Identical workload/topology inputs and resource assumptions are recorded for comparisons. Delivery counts come from recipient acceptance events, not TX completion or CCA-clear; latency is computed only over its declared delivered population and reported with loss/expiry denominators. A zero-delivery scenario remains failed with undefined/no latency improvement. Hand-enumerated outcome ledgers catch report omissions, false success and mismatched airtime totals. Report/result tests run reproducibly against actual scenario outputs.
